ledger.hypothesis: At 64 CVs the arithmetic is nothing; the tick is per-call overhead -- a dozen shared_ptr<vector> allocations for linspace/zeros/add/reshape/stack, a std::vector<MPoint> then an MPointArray copy, and 20 MDoubleArray::append calls for knots that never change. Removing every allocation except the unavoidable MFnNurbsSurfaceData::create + MFnNurbsSurface::create should roughly halve the compute; the same double expression in the same order keeps the result bit-identical.
